combat-turn-order-speed-stat: Turn order is by speed stat descending; ties go to party members first.

- `TurnQueue.Build` queues by speed descending. On ties, party members go before enemies (user decision 2026-09-12).
- Changing tie rules breaks all boss balance tables.
combat-crit-roll-uses-seeded-rng: Crit rolls use a seeded RNG fixed per battle — UnityEngine.Random is forbidden.

- `BattleRng(seed)` handles both crits and dodges. Mixing in `UnityEngine.Random` breaks replays (trap).
- Seed lives in `BattleContext.Seed`.
combat-status-effect-stack-cap: Status effects stack to max 3; duration resets to the longest.

- Poison and burn cap at 3 stacks. Overflow only refreshes duration to the longest value.
- Stack limit is owned by `StatusConfig.asset`.
combat-damage-formula-armor: Damage formula: attack × multiplier − armor × 0.5, minimum 1.

- `DamageCalc.Compute` owns it. Minimum 1 is a design requirement.
- Armor-piercing skills change the 0.5 coefficient to 0.2.
combat-skill-cooldown-in-turns: Skill cooldowns are in turns, not seconds.
- Cooldown decrements by 1 when your turn ends. Enemy turns don't count.
ui-dialogue-box-pixel-perfect: Dialogue boxes scale 9-slice only by integer multiples of Pixel Perfect Camera ratio.
- Non-integer ratios blur border pixels (trap). `PixelPerfectCamera.assetsPPU` is 16.
ui-inventory-grid-drag: Inventory drag-and-drop needs 0.15 seconds hover to swap.
- Immediate swap caused frequent bugs during scrolling. 0.15s delay was user request.
ui-font-korean-bitmap: Use only one bitmap font for Korean: Galmuri11.
- Use TMP font asset `Galmuri11 SDF`. Mixing other Korean fonts causes line height jitter.
ui-hp-bar-tween: HP bar shows white afterimage trailing 0.4s after damage.
- `HpBar.Damage` depletes the front bar instantly and the white trail after 0.4s.
save-json-version-migration: Save is JSON; use version field to migrate old saves.

- `SaveSystem.Load` checks version and applies `Migrations` in order.
- Don't delete fields—rename only—or old saves break (incident 2026-09-20).
save-autosave-on-scene-change: Autosave only right before scene change — never during combat.
- Saving mid-combat half-serializes the turn queue, crashing on load (trap).
save-path-persistent-data: - 3 slots total. Cloud sync not yet implemented.
build-addressables-before-player: Build Addressables before building the player.

- Wrong order runs but leaves monster sprites blank (trap).
- `Tools/Build/All` menu keeps the order.
build-steam-depot-upload: Steam upload uses 2 depots — Windows and Mac.
- Use `steam_build/app_build.vdf`. Notarize Mac build before upload.
build-il2cpp-stripping: IL2CPP code stripping deletes serialization classes using reflection — link.xml needed.
- Keep `SaveData` namespace in `Assets/link.xml`. Missing it breaks loads on release builds only.
db-migration-knex-order: Run migrations with knex only, in chronological order by filename.
- Manual SQL schema changes cause migration conflicts on next deploy (incident 2026-09-02).
db-order-status-enum: Order status: pending, paid, brewing, done, canceled.
db-connection-pool-size: Connection pool size is 10; reduce to 1 when moving to serverless.
- Larger pools exceed DB max connections.
auth-jwt-refresh-rotation: Refresh token is reissued on every use; old ones revoked immediately.
- Reuse detected triggers full token revocation for that user (security decision).
auth-staff-role: Staff roles are staff and owner; only owner can refund.
deploy-fly-io-secrets: Deploy on fly.io; inject secrets only via fly secrets.
- Don't bake `.env` into the image. Use `fly secrets set`.
deploy-healthcheck-db: Healthcheck includes database ping — otherwise dead instances get traffic.
deploy-payment-webhook-idempotent: Payment webhook uses paymentKey for idempotency.
- Same webhook arrives multiple times. Prevent with `payments.payment_key` unique constraint (trap).
swiftdata-migration-plan: When changing SwiftData schema, commit VersionedSchema and migration plan together.
- Missing it crashes updated users' apps on launch (incident).
streak-timezone: Streak counting uses the user's timezone, not UTC.
- Counting in UTC breaks international users' streaks (user report).
haptics-on-check: Checking a habit triggers light haptic feedback once — no success haptic.
- User preference: success haptic was too loud.
unity-serializefield-rename: When renaming serialized fields, add FormerlySerializedAs.
- Missing it silently loses values in prefabs (trap).
unity-coroutine-disabled-object: Coroutines don't start from disabled objects.
- Calling from a disabled object fails silently.
unity-meta-files-commit: - Missing them breaks all prefab references as Missing on other PCs.
node-esm-dirname: ESM has no __dirname — use import.meta.url instead.
commit-message-korean: Commit messages in Korean; prefixes: feat, fix, refactor, chore.
- User decision. One commit = one task.
ask-before-delete: Before deleting files, say what will be lost first.
